node.statement: The ambient objects have the required types and common witness package because lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation supplies W_RF and S, lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness supplies the fixed Delta', and lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness supplies the fixed Delta from that same Delta'; thus lem-routef-upsilon-prime-closeness applies to the fixed Upsilon'.
